fields.description: First tag byte of EEPROM block 48 ('D' = 0x44). Block framing confirmed by FUN_08041fc0 8-byte read; value observed in baseline.sav logical domain.
fields.evidence: FUN_08041fc0 reads one 8-byte EEPROM block (4x u16 via FUN_08041f40 serial transfer on uRam0d000000) into RAM; FUN_0804214c verifies the block as 4 shorts and FUN_080421a4 (write via FUN_08042070 + verify) commits it. Baseline block 48 at logical file offset 0x180 holds 0x44 here (bin_peek --rev8).
fields.name: blk48_tag_b0

fields.description: Second tag byte of EEPROM block 48 ('E' = 0x45). Value observed in baseline.sav logical domain.
fields.evidence: Same 8-byte block transfer as blk48_tag_b0: FUN_08041fc0 / FUN_08042070 / FUN_080421a4 / FUN_0804214c. Baseline logical offset 0x181 holds 0x45 (bin_peek --rev8).
fields.name: blk48_tag_b1

fields.description: Third tag byte of EEPROM block 48 ('S' = 0x53). Value observed in baseline.sav logical domain.
fields.evidence: Same 8-byte block transfer as blk48_tag_b0: FUN_08041fc0 / FUN_08042070 / FUN_080421a4 / FUN_0804214c. Baseline logical offset 0x182 holds 0x53 (bin_peek --rev8).
fields.name: blk48_tag_b2

fields.description: Fourth tag byte of EEPROM block 48 ('I' = 0x49). Completes the 'DESI' block tag. Value observed in baseline.sav logical domain.
fields.evidence: Same 8-byte block transfer as blk48_tag_b0: FUN_08041fc0 / FUN_08042070 / FUN_080421a4 / FUN_0804214c. Baseline logical offset 0x183 holds 0x49 (bin_peek --rev8).
fields.name: blk48_tag_b3

fields.description: Third little-endian halfword of EEPROM block 48; reads 0 in baseline. Structural word of the save block (role unknown; owner absent from partial decomp). Mutable: safe for live-mutation probing.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804214c compares the EEPROM block as 4 shorts and FUN_08041fc0 stores it via (ushort *)(param_2 + 6), grounding u16 granularity. Baseline logical offset 0x184 holds u16_le 0 (bin_peek --rev8, bytes 00 00).
fields.name: blk48_body_zero

fields.description: Fourth little-endian halfword of EEPROM block 48; reads 1 in baseline. Plausibly a save-sequence counter or first-save marker (role unconfirmed; owner absent from partial decomp). Mutable: safe for live-mutation probing.
fields.evidence: FUN_0804214c compares the EEPROM block as 4 shorts and FUN_08041fc0 stores it via (ushort *)(param_2 + 6), grounding u16 granularity. Baseline logical offset 0x186 holds u16_le 1 (bin_peek --rev8, bytes 01 00). Written through FUN_08042070 / FUN_080421a4.
fields.name: blk48_seq_counter
